subject: Proposal: transition annual contract to Azure Marketplace billing - Veridian Health
messages:
From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
To: Laura Kim <laura.kim@veridianhealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 12 Jul 2026 16:17:00 -0400
Subject: Proposal: transition annual contract to Azure Marketplace billing - Veridian Health

Hi Laura,

Thanks again for the great conversation last week. Per our discussion, attached is a concise plan to move Veridian's annual Redwood Inference subscription onto Azure Marketplace billing so your procurement and finance teams can pay via your existing cloud contract.

High-level benefits:
- Single invoice on your Azure bill (no separate vendor invoices)
- Leverage your existing SCE/EA discounts
- Simplified renewal cadence aligned to your cloud contract

What I attached: a one-page order form and a short Azure listing checklist showing the minimal steps on both sides. Estimated timeline: 3–4 weeks from signature (depends on your procurement lead time).

Immediate ask: can you confirm your procurement contact (name + email) so I can include them on the order form and the DocuSign envelope? If you prefer, I can prepare a version for direct signature from you and forward to procurement.

Thanks — I’ll follow up with Marissa (she owns Marketplace ops) on the technical checklist once we have procurement details.

Best,
Jonas
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
[jonas.weber@redwood.com] | +1 (415) 555-0192
[Attachment: Veridian-Azure-Order-Form.pdf (PDF)]
[Attachment: Azure-Listing-Checklist.xlsx (Excel)]

From: Laura Kim <laura.kim@veridianhealth.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
Cc: Procurement <procurement@veridianhealth.com>
Date: Mon, 13 Jul 2026 10:04:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Proposal: transition annual contract to Azure Marketplace billing - Veridian Health

Jonas — thanks for this and for the clear plan. A few procurement questions before we loop legal: 

1) Will the Marketplace model change our current SSO/SCIM integration setup? (we want zero downtime)
2) Any differences to data residency / logging we should be aware of?
3) How do refunds/credits work if we overprovision mid-year?

Procurement contact is Ben Carter (copied). Ben — can you confirm whether you need an internal PO before DocuSign? If so, I’ll ask finance to issue. Otherwise we can sign via DocuSign and route invoice through Azure.

Thanks,
Laura
Director of Product | Veridian Health
[laura.kim@veridianhealth.com]

From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
To: Laura Kim <laura.kim@veridianhealth.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@veridianhealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Sergio Alvarez <sergio_alvarez@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 13 Jul 2026 13:05:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Proposal: transition annual contract to Azure Marketplace billing - Veridian Health

Laura / Ben — great questions. Quick answers below and next steps.

1) SSO/SCIM: No changes to your SSO provider. The Marketplace listing uses the same account link; we’ll coordinate a short maintenance window for the initial entitlement sync (typically <30 minutes). Marissa will own the schedule and rollback plan.

2) Data residency/logging: Your data stays in the same region your deployment currently uses; Marketplace billing does not alter data flows or retention. We will provide the updated audit log slice for your compliance team for the transition window.

3) Refunds/credits: Azure Marketplace has a settlement process; in practice we issue a credit on our side that maps to a usage adjustment in Azure. If you expect significant mid-year changes, we can set a monthly usage reconciliation cadence to minimize surprises.

Attached: a version of the order form with procurement fields filled and a short checklist for your finance team. Next steps I propose:
- Ben: confirm need for internal PO by EOD Wed 7/15
- Procurement/Finance: indicate preferred DocuSign signers
- Marissa: will kick off the Azure listing prep and schedule entitlement sync once PO/signature is OK

If PO is required, we can start parallel tasks (we don’t need the PO to prepare the listing).

Best,
Jonas
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
[Attachment: Veridian-Azure-Order-Form-filled.pdf]
[Attachment: Azure-Listing-Checklist.xlsx]
